import urllib.request,urllib.error,json
root="https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/"
for item in ["campaigns_api.php","ops.php","calls_feed.php"]:
 request=urllib.request.Request(root+item,headers={"Cache-Control":"no-cache","User-Agent":"OnTrack-Pilot-Verification"})
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=8) as r:status=r.status
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:status=e.code
 print(json.dumps({"resource":item,"unauthenticated_status":status}))
 assert (item=="ops.php" and status==403) or (item!="ops.php" and status==401), "Unexpected access control result"
